newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds capped by 108-06 on upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds capped by 108-06 on upside.

text.p: June T-bonds will be hemmed in by support at 107-16 and resistance at 108-06 on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
"The market is in limbo," said Adrian Sells, director of Crane Investment Analysis here. "It's toying with key areas and finding no momentum one way or another."
Analysts said the fact T-bonds failed to make much headway after breaking through key resistance at 107-28 last Thursday, was disappointing for Treasury bulls.
T-bonds stalled at 108-07 on April 17, 108-06 on April 18 and 108-06 on April 21.
Analysts said a break out either side of its present tight range -- which is likely to be triggered by fundamentals rather than technicals -- was needed to determine longer term direction.
By 0947 GMT, the June T-bond was down 2/32 at 107-19. The 30-year long bond was at 94-05, unchanged from Tokyo and down from 94-08 at the New York close.
Sells said the market would aim for 109-00 if it managed to pierce 108-06 resistance and added the 107-15 close on April 16 should hold on the downside.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here said daily stochastics were supportive near term in T-bonds, but added any gains were not expected to extend much past 109-12,14.
They said 109-12 is the 38.2 percent retracement of the slide from 114-08 on February 18 to 106-12 on April 11 on continuation charts.
DMG said support was at the intra-day gap at 107-16, 20 on day-session only charts.
"Closing the gap or failure to push through the 108-07 barrier this week would allow a retracement lower to 107-03," they said.
DMG said 107-03 is the 61.8 percent retracement of the short term rally from the 106-12 low on April 11 to the 108-07 high on April 17 on continuation charts.
"Key support below here remains at the 106-12 April 11 low," they said.
